verdict.rationale: Circle is API-first: it offers REST APIs for creating wallets, signing transactions and authorizing actions, plus idempotency keys for safe automated retries. It also has an official CLI that drives wallets, transfers, bridging and contract execution through a single command interface, and Agent Wallets are documented to transact autonomously within defined policies, so headless automation is clearly supported. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD guidance (e.g. non-interactive CLI auth via env vars or tokens, pipeline examples), and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use in CI.
